suno.estilo: Short defeat jingle: sorrowful and gentle, never punishing. Melancholic acoustic chamber folk for a dark fantasy game. Recorded live in a small stone chapel: natural medium reverb, warm close mics, organic human timing. Core ensemble: nylon-string guitar, lute, psaltery, low cello, wooden flute, small metal bells, singing bowls. A sighing low cello phrase over one soft guitar chord, a single low bell, a crystalline psaltery fading away like salt. Stays in D minor, steady 60 BPM, 3/4. Form: 3-bar phrase, long reverb tail, then silence.
